name: 02 GraphRAG · Dokumente mit Chunk- & Entity-Anzahl
query:
MATCH (d:T3Doc)
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)<-[:PART_OF]-(c:T3Chunk)
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:MENTIONS]->(e:T3Entity)
RETURN d.doc_id AS dokument, count(DISTINCT c) AS chunks, count(DISTINCT e) AS entities
ORDER BY entities DESC

name: 02 GraphRAG · Entity-Typen (Verteilung)
query:
MATCH (e:T3Entity)
RETURN e.type AS typ, count(*) AS anzahl
ORDER BY anzahl DESC

name: 02 GraphRAG · Meist erwaehnte Entities (Hubs)
query:
MATCH (e:T3Entity)<-[:MENTIONS]-(d:T3Doc)
RETURN e.name AS entity, e.type AS typ, count(DISTINCT d) AS dokumente
ORDER BY dokumente DESC
LIMIT 20

name: 02 GraphRAG · Geteilte Entities = die Graph-Kanten
query:
MATCH (a:T3Doc)-[:MENTIONS]->(e:T3Entity)<-[:MENTIONS]-(b:T3Doc)
WHERE a.doc_id < b.doc_id
RETURN a.doc_id AS dok_a, b.doc_id AS dok_b,
       count(DISTINCT e) AS gemeinsame, collect(DISTINCT e.name) AS entities
ORDER BY gemeinsame DESC
LIMIT 25

name: 02 GraphRAG · Graph-Expansion ab einem Dokument
query:
// :param doc_id => 'madeira'   (oder $doc_id durch ein Literal ersetzen)
MATCH (hit:T3Doc {doc_id: $doc_id})-[:MENTIONS]->(e:T3Entity)<-[:MENTIONS]-(related:T3Doc)
WHERE related <> hit
RETURN related.doc_id AS verwandtes_dokument,
       count(DISTINCT e) AS staerke, collect(DISTINCT e.name) AS via_entities
ORDER BY staerke DESC

name: 02 GraphRAG · Dokumente zu einer Entity finden
query:
// :param entity => 'wandern'
MATCH (e:T3Entity {name: $entity})<-[:MENTIONS]-(d:T3Doc)
RETURN d.doc_id AS dokument
ORDER BY dokument

name: 02 GraphRAG · Gemeinsame Entities zweier Dokumente
02 GraphRAG · Dokumente ohne Entities (Extraktion pruefen)
query:
MATCH (d:T3Doc)
WHERE NOT (d)-[:MENTIONS]->(:T3Entity)
RETURN d.doc_id AS dokument_ohne_entities

name: 02 GraphRAG · Verwaiste Entities (von niemandem erwaehnt)
query:
MATCH (e:T3Entity)
WHERE NOT (e)<-[:MENTIONS]-(:T3Doc)
RETURN e.name AS entity, e.type AS typ

name: 02 GraphRAG · Knowledge Graph visualisieren (Doc-Entity)
query:
MATCH p=(:T3Doc)-[:MENTIONS]->(:T3Entity)
RETURN p
LIMIT 300

name: 03 Vektor · Chunks mit/ohne Embedding (stale-Erkennung)
query:
MATCH (c:T3Chunk)
RETURN c.embedding IS NOT NULL AS hat_embedding, count(*) AS anzahl

name: 03 Vektor · Embedding-Dimension pruefen
query:
MATCH (c:T3Chunk)
WHERE c.embedding IS NOT NULL
RETURN size(c.embedding) AS dimensionen
LIMIT 1

name: 03 Vektor · Aehnlichkeitssuche Top-k (Vector Index)
query:
// :param query_vector => [0.01, 0.02, ...]   (1024 floats, z.B. aus embed(frage))
CALL db.index.vector.queryNodes('t3_chunk_embeddings', 5, $query_vector)
YIELD node, score
RETURN node.doc_id AS dokument, node.seq AS chunk, left(node.text, 120) AS auszug, score
ORDER BY score DESC

name: 03 Vektor · Chunks eines Dokuments anzeigen
query:
// :param doc_id => 'madeira'
MATCH (c:T3Chunk {doc_id: $doc_id})
RETURN c.seq AS seq, c.text AS text
ORDER BY seq
